direction: Daily base-volume-weighted moving close with symmetric price hysteresis
hypothesis: Use greater weight on high-base-volume daily closes to test whether the causal trend anchor survives whipsaw and execution costs. Daily close times day volume is an indicator proxy,not traded VWAP,aggressor flow or profitability evidence.

sources.scope: Primary formula sums close*volume over rolling sum volume;source only,our rational implementation and trading grid independently frozen,no library or code copy.
Official indicator formula only,not a profitable strategy endorsement or bitwise equivalence claim.
Official spot filter definitions;actual historical filters remain unavailable.

rule.signal: On each completed UTC signal dayj, VWMA_L=sum(C_i*V_i)/sum(V_i),i=j-L+1..j,includingj;C is last closed minute close,V is sum of1440closed-minute base-asset volumes. Exact Fraction from daily Float64decimal strings,canonical ratioSHA,Decimal60display only. NeedLclosed days,no padding. If window volume iszero,preserve actual position without a trade.
rule.exit: When actually long,exit iff C_j<VWMA_L*(1-b),strict;equality/deadband preserves position. No short,leverage,add-on,transfer,cash interest or same-decision reentry;costed terminal liquidation.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

grid.arithmetic: Exact Fraction of daily Float64 decimal-string encoded close and base volume;Decimal60 display only;accounting Decimal28 unchanged

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.
validation.purging: No fitting or future-return labels;label purge inapplicable.365day context and3day initial gap;fixed rules and two-axis grid,12chronological30day folds,continuous account,no OOS reset or selection.
validation.continuous_drawdown: Initial capital,all closed OOS minute-close NAVs and immediate post-fill reference marks;no fold reset or intraminute extrema.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Unchanged2026-10-14 frozen public exchangeInfo proxy,compared to current response in filter_check.json. Frozen SHA is reused;current retrieval time cannot manufacture novelty. Historical L2/filter rules unavailable.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.
